edges: Moll's first husband went bankrupt and fled to the Continent.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Blanco Posnet is accused of stealing a horse belonging to the Sheriff.
Moll learned that her son is alive after arriving in the Colonies.
The woman was given the horse by a man on the road.
Blanco offers to marry Feemy in thanks for her help.
The elder son convinced Moll to marry his younger brother.
Moll Flanders was raised by a goodly foster mother until adolescence.
Moll married Bretton, who cheated her into marriage.
Blanco offers to shake Feemy's hand.
Moll Flanders married a kindly man who introduced her to his mother.
Moll Flanders became involved with banker Callum Murray, who was still married.
Blanco left his brother's house before being accused.
The elder son convinced Moll to marry his younger brother.
Moll revealed her entire story to her Lancashire husband after her brother/husband died.
The woman denies that Blanco was the man who gave her the horse.
Moll and a Quaker founded a farm with 50 servants in Maryland.
Moll Flanders is the daughter of Moll's mother.
